# ARKhives 8.21.1

ARKdaily uses the supplied Gravity collection: 2,272 questions, four trivia posts and 1,730 matching illustrations. Original-scan panels are removed; cropped illustrations support enlargement. Existing saved Daily posts refresh to the new collection. Missing workbook explanations are clearly identified while their answers remain available.

ARKdaily opens directly into the feed with a larger Tiko. The introductory banner, category filters and subject selector are removed. Saved posts remain available from the compact bookmark control beside Tiko settings.

Cards, answer choices, explanations and source notices now use the application theme in both dark and light mode. Submitted answers retain readable contrast. Phone layouts give Tiko roughly twice the previous width, with the feed and bottom navigation remaining accessible.

Tiko now uses the complete supplied ARKbot_Animated rig, with all 24 motion states, full intensity, pointer/touch tracking and idle gestures. Reduced-motion preferences and the calm setting remain available; sounds default off. The superseded character-part payload is removed from both interfaces and the offline shell cache.

Official question banks, scheduling, notes and personal progress are unchanged. ARKdaily still awards no study credit or FSRS ratings.
